note: A real 8.0.1 review, as the library saved it: a competitive Split match the watch ended at 3 to 5 in round 9 after locking swiftplay wrongly (the session is valorant-session-split-competitive.json). No ledger, endedBy score, unverified. Riot has the match going on to 13 to 7 (riot-split-13-7.json). Study notes kept as their text alone.

patterns.text: 2 of your 7 deaths were at B Back, in rounds 2, 3.
You lost 3 rounds in a row, rounds 6 to 8.
Attack was your stronger side: won 3 of 5 on attack and 0 of 3 on defence.
On attack, won 1 of 2 rounds once the spike was down.

notes: A full grade needs Riot's record of the match. Add your Riot ID in Settings and it grades itself a few minutes after the match.

review.summary: You lost the match five to three. Holding B Back alone in rounds 2 and 3 led to repeated deaths. On attack you won by entering checkpoints and surviving behind cover before your team arrived.
review.focus: Enter sites in checkpoints and wait for your team to catch up before taking the next piece of space to avoid dying alone.

study.text: Giving ground is not losing the site, falling back to a crossfire you can trade from beats dying alone at the choke.
Entry in checkpoints, take one piece of space, survive behind cover, then wait for the team to reach you before you take the next.
Decide how you are taking an angle before you arrive at it, the way you pick the lane before the turn, hesitating at the corner is what gets you traded.
